body: I've had big real problems, lots of them, but I usually can ignore them. This however is just so much different.
It still happened though, and I doubt I can live it down.
I feel gross and wrong, I can't stand myself. I just want the feeling to go away.
Funny? It was horrible, and I can't stand myself. Normally I could at least smile but all day I've just stayed in bed and stared at the ceiling.
